questions.stem: A student uses diameter in sphere surface area 4 pi d^2. What is effect? "Surface area is 8 times too large" is the answer a classmate submitted. Diagnose the mistake in that choice, then select the option that is fully correct.

options.text: Surface area is 8 times too large
Surface area is 4 times too large
Surface area is 2 times too large

questions.explanation: d=2r, d^2=4r^2, so 4 times. Surface area is 4 times too large. The A answer comes from cubing instead of squaring: surface area is 8 times too large. The B answer arises from using a linear factor instead of a squared one: surface area is 2 times too large. The D answer comes from assuming the diameter substitution has no effect: no effect is the correct choice here. That is the relation that decides the figure.
